title: Workflow custom templates
description: Reusable, deterministic work-structure templates for bwrk (Approach A from design discussion 2026-07-02). Templates are versioned declarative YAML files (new kind under templates/, distinct from prose output contracts) declaring metadata (id, version, variables), a tree of nodes (kind issue/sprint/task/milestone, title/description/labels/acceptance with {{var}} substitution, gates, optional per-step binding: workflow ref, md output contract, or command) plus dependency edges. New CLI surface: bwrk template list|show|validate|capture|run. capture snapshots an existing epic into a template file; run deterministically executes create/dep/ready in one ledger-consistent operation with --var substitution, labelling created items with template id + run id and linking the new epic back to the template and prior runs. Re-run model: fresh instance per run (template is a mold; closed runs stay closed). Terminal steps are ordinary template tasks (e.g. a produce-report task), not special machinery.
acceptanceCriteria: bwrk template list/show/validate/capture/run are implemented, documented, and pass doctor --strict
An end-to-end example template (e.g. bug-finding mission) can be captured, run twice with different --var values, and produces two independent instances linked to the template
Each child sprint closed with git checkpoint commit(s) or a recorded no-commit reason code
closedReason: All workflow custom template sprints closed with evidence and dirty-path checkpoint coverage.
